reports.title: Ryman Hospitality Properties, Inc. Reports Third Quarter 2026 Results

guidance.heading: 2026 Guidance
section: The Company is updating its 2026 business performance outlook based on current information as of November 2, 2026. The Company does not expect to update the guidance provided below before next quarter’s earnings release. However, the Company may update or withdraw its full business outlook or any portion thereof at any time for any reason.

Fioravanti concluded, “We are pleased to raise the midpoints of our 2026 guidance ranges to reflect performance in our same-store Hospitality business, partially offset by lower Entertainment expectations related primarily to the closure of the General Jackson Showboat. We are cautiously optimistic on fourth quarter hotel leisure trends, as early demand indicators including ice! ticket sales and leisure room night bookings for the holiday period are trending positively. At the midpoint of our outlook, AFFO per diluted share is expected to grow approximately 10% year over year. We believe this level of growth is particularly meaningful given the outlook includes a partial year contribution of Grande Lakes Orlando operations and the share dilution from our recent equity offering.”
